397e91c54aa0107a244d42b78d6f4094879bbbe2.summary: BleepingComputer reports, citing CNN and U.S. officials, that Chinese state-backed group Silk Typhoon (Hafnium) reportedly breached the Treasury's CFIUS and OFAC offices, using a stolen BeyondTrust Remote Support API key. Bloomberg attributed the attack to Silk Typhoon. The Office of Financial Research was also reportedly hacked, and its impact is still being assessed. CISA said other federal agencies were not affected. The group has attacked defense contractors, policy think tanks, NGOs, healthcare, law firms and higher education in the United States, Australia, Japan and Vietnam, and…
